messages:
maya: Quick async — gated rollout checklist for SDK v0.9.2. Will be short.
maya: What I did: pushed release branch, updated changelog, opened PR #1423 (link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/1423)
maya: Blockers: windows CI failing on native extension compile, need a tiny tweak to build flags; also need final signoff from @alex on API surface.
alex: on it, will review PR today. Regarding API — can we keep backwards compat for `client.generate()`? I think yes, just deprecated third param.
maya: yep plan is to keep `generate()` stable, added overloads, docs updated.
sam: pinging to run local smoke: which command to test? can't find quickstart updated.
maya: run `pip install -e .[dev]` then `python examples/quickstart.py` — updated example to v0.9 signatures.
ria: FYI integration tests failing on windows-latest: error building wheel for tokenizers. I can reproduce locally.
leo: for windows, try adding `CFLAGS='/DWIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN'` to build env, worked for me in past. Also maybe pin `setuptools<65`?
ria: trying CFLAGS now, will report.
dev-bot: CI update — linux/amd64 passed, macos passed, windows failed — details: https://ci.redwood.ai/gh/12345
alex: if windows fix is a quick env tweak we can still proceed with canary in Dedicated tomorrow, otherwise postpone to Friday. Thoughts?
maya: agree — if ria confirms fix by EOD we proceed. If not, hold canary. I'll prepare canary config and flag rollback route.
sam: small doc nit: quickstart README still references old env var `REDWOOD_KEY_LEGACY`, should change to `REDWOOD_API_KEY`. I'll open tiny PR.
maya: thanks, Sam. adding to checklist.
ria: CFLAGS worked, windows build now passes locally. I'll re-run CI.
dev-bot: CI update — windows fixed on re-run, all checks green ✅
alex: LGTM, approving PR now. :thumbsup:
maya: awesome, starting canary rollout config in console (canary 5% traffic, 10 min ramp). I'll post updates.
leo: good luck — ping if you need rollback help.
maya: will do. end of async.
